'''Waif''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Waif lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], the Tarasin homeworld, where she was a member of the [[Bark Lovers' Alliance]], a local environmental group. She worked in the Alliance's office in the city of [[Gadrin]] and knew [[Selima DeWitt]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Trade Wars: Find the Lady|Find the Lady]]'', the player characters can speak to Waif if they visit the Alliance's office.

The term "[[Wikipedia:waif|waif]]" refers to a being who, either by hardship, loss, or similar circumstances, were removed from their original surroundings. The usage of such a term is to denote a homeless or orphaned child, similar to "street urchin" or "ragamuffin".
